issues.what: The view switches in one frame from the low rear three-quarter to the front three-quarter. The pullback itself eases, but the handoff jumps to the opposite side of the car before it starts.
issues.fix: Begin the return from the outgoing rear pose and use an eased wraparound pullback that settles into the same opening camera pose.

issues.where: 8.97–9.00 s and the later insert boundaries at 15, 20, 25 and 29 s
issues.what: The camera changes position, angle or scale from one frame to the next. These play as hard edits between individually plausible shots, not as no-jump camera moves.
issues.fix: If the no-jump requirement applies across beats, bridge the setups with eased rig moves or motivated occlusions while retaining the insert holds. Otherwise explicitly mark the hard cuts as intentional in the shot plan.

issues.what: The five-second wheel move stays almost square to the sidewall, giving the tread little screen space for the planned water action.
issues.fix: Arc slightly around the front wheel and ease into a short hold that exposes both the tread shoulder and the arch.
